tha)pa la/gter ston rgyal po lnga yi gsum par byon pa o rgyan rdo rje gling pa'i yang gter/bla ma'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i las byang le'u gas

tei:div.tei:p: tha) pa la/ gter ston rgyal po lnga yi gsum par byon pa o rgyan rdo rje gling pa'i yang gter/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i las byang le'u gsum pa gu ru badz+ra bho ṭas gnam lcags 'bar ba'i brag logs rta mgrin sgrub phug mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chen mo nas gdan drangs pa/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i mchod bstod zur bkol bla ma'i thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa'i las byang gi lhan thabs su sbyar ba/ bla ma bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i dbang bskur chen mo bklags chog tu bkod pa rin chen dbyig gi rdzing bu/ bla ma bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i don dbang bskur ba'i yi ge rin chen dbyig gi snying po/ gter chen rdo rje gling pa'i yang gter/ rdzogs chen snying po hūm̐ skor las/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum gyi sgrub thabs dang phrin las gung bsdebs pa ye shes rol pa'i snying po/ rdzogs pa chen po hūm̐ skor las/ smin byed dbang lnga mthar chags su bskur ba'i lag len ye shes rol pa'i chu rgyun/ rdzogs pa chen po hūm̐ skor snying thig gi khrid 'chad thabs mdor bsdus/ rdzogs pa chen po snying po hūm̐ gi skor las/ rang byung nyams len khrid kyi sngon 'gro/ rdzogs chen hūm̐ skor las/ bar do'i ma yig /rdzogs chen hūm̐ skor las/ gcod yul snang ba lam khyer/ rdzogs pa chen po snying po hūm̐ gi skor las/ zhi byed rin chen phra bkod/ rdzogs chen snying po hūm̐ skor las/ gtum mo dran chog me 'bar/ rdzogs chen snying po hūm̐ skor las/ 'od gsal shes bya bum 'jug chos rgyal rin chen gling pa'i yang gter/ rdzogs chen chig chod kun grol gyi skor kun grol them byang nas lung bstan gtad rgya'i bar chos tshan bco lnga dkyus gcig tu bkod pa/ rdzogs pa chen po yang ti nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig pa'i don gyi phrin las khrigs su bsdebs pa thos grol ye shes sgra dbyangs/

rdzogs pa chen po chig chod kun grol las/ dbang bzhi'i brda khrid bklags chog tu bkod pa gnas lugs gcer mthong*/ rdzogs pa chen po gcig chod kun grol las/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi khrid rim mdor bsdus pa 'ching ba kun grol/ grub mchog tshul khrims bzang po'i yang gter/ thugs rje chen po yi ge drug pa'i gsol 'debs kyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs can/ thugs rje chen po yi ge drug pa'i gsol 'debs sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i rig gtad kyi cho ga mchog dman snying gi bdud rtsi/ jo bo thugs rjai chen po'i smyung gnas kyi cho ga'i khrid yig gsal ba'i sgron me/ gter chen pad+ma gling pa'i dngos slob 'gro 'dul las 'phro gling pa'i yang gter/ thugs rje chen po don gsal sgron me las/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ thugs rje chen po don gsal sgron me las/ las byang rin chen phreng ba/ thugs rje chen po don gsal sgron me las/ dbang bskur gyi rim pa dkyus gcig tu bkod pa mthong chog sgron me/ sprul pa'i gter chen rig 'dzin mchog ldan mgon po'am o rgyan mdo sngags gling pa'i yang gter/ dpal rta mgrin gnyen po lha lnga snyan brgyud snying po'i yang zhun/ snyan brgyud rta mgrin gnyen po lha lnga'i phrin las dbang bskur dang bcas pa gdug pa kun 'joms/ lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi zab gter/ tshe g.yang 'gugs pa'i phrin las khrigs su bsdebs pa tshe bsod 'dod rgu'i dpal ster/ tshe g.yang 'gug pa la sbyar rgyu'i bsang mchod 'dod rgu'i sprin phung*/ tshe g.yang 'gugs pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor nyung ngu*/ gter chen shes rab 'od zer gyi yang gter/ grol thig zhi khro'i brgyud 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs/ grol tig dgongs pa rang grol gyi chos sde/ zhi khro'i bskyed rdzogs kyi phrin las khrigs su bsdebs pa 'od gsal snying po/ dam pa rigs brgya'i lha dbang gi bkol byang*/
grol tig zhi khro'i dbang bskur gyi cho ga sdig sgrib rgyun gcod/ pad+ma'i zhal gdams grol thig mthong ba rang grol las/ chos nyid klong bshags/
